summary: Infinity Solutions' policy sets scheduling and availability rules for approved remote employees, full-time or part-time. It requires availability during core hours of 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM local time while allowing flexibility for the remaining work commitment. It also covers scheduling transparency, time off, collaboration tools, and equal performance accountability.
one_line: Infinity Solutions' remote work policy requires availability during 10 AM-3 PM core hours, with flexible scheduling, transparency, and the same performance standards as on-site staff.
key_facts: Infinity Solutions designates core work hours from 10:00 AM to 3:00 PM local time for remote employees.
During core hours, remote employees must be actively working and promptly available for communication.
Core hours are critical for real-time collaboration among team members and responsiveness to client inquiries.
Remote employees may complete the remainder of their work commitment outside core hours under the flexibility window.
Workers are encouraged to align their peak productivity periods with job responsibilities.
Outside core hours, employees should communicate their general availability and provide contact information for urgent matters.
Team members should make reasonable efforts to attend all scheduled meetings and inform relevant parties in advance if unable to do so.
Remote employees must update calendars with work hours, meetings and planned focus periods.
Remote employees must notify supervisors and team of any deviations from standard working hours.
Remote employees must use company-approved tools to indicate availability status (e.g., online, busy, away).
Remote employees are entitled to the same statutory breaks and time off as in-office workers.
Personal time off requests must follow company policy with reasonable advance notice.
Remote employees are held to the same performance standards as on-premises workers, with supervisors monitoring outputs, project progress and overall performance.
The policy applies to all employees approved for remote work, whether full-time or part-time.
